description: Get the full nutrition facts of one food: energy, carbohydrate, sugars, dietary fiber, protein, fat, saturated fat, trans fat, cholesterol and sodium, per serving and per 100 g/ml, with % of the Korean daily reference values. Nutrients the manufacturer has not disclosed are marked "제조사 미공개" (not disclosed), and estimated values carry an "AI 추정치, 참고용" flag. Includes the source page URL. If no exact name match exists, the closest match is returned and similar names are listed.

food.description: Korean food name, a foodNumber, or a https://dietcamera.doinglab.com/food/... page URL returned by search_food
